description: This file implements the backend for IPv6-in-IPv4 tunneling using the 6rd protocol in a network configuration script for OpenWrt. It contains functions to set up and tear down 6rd tunnels, initialize configuration parameters, and manage routing and addressing details specific to 6rd tunnels.

methods.name: proto_6rd_setup
methods.description: Sets up a 6rd IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel with provided configuration, including IP address calculation, routing, and tunnel parameters.

methods.name: proto_6rd_teardown
methods.description: Tears down or cleans up the 6rd tunnel setup based on provided configuration.

methods.name: proto_6rd_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration for 6rd protocol, defining parameters that can be set by user or system.
